messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high error-rate for tenant 'lynx' in eu2 (dedicated pool). Automated detection triggered. Alert details: 5xx spike on rtx-infer endpoints, 42% of requests failing over last 3m. Link: https://alerts.redwood/2264508888

oncall-javi: I'm on it. Paging SRE + ENG. Assigning to @sre-maya for triage. Any customer-reported impact?

sre-maya: seeing elevated 5xx in eu2 dedicated pool for lynx. Errors look like connection resets to model workers, and some KV cache hot-evictions. Checking node health and GPU heartbeat.

eng-ralph: echo — looking at runtime logs, qcache misses increase then OOM-ish galloc failures on a subset of nodes. Could be noisy neighbor or network perf. Pulling pool audit.

cs-ana: I messaged lynx on their SSO contact channel. They've noticed increased tail latency and ~20% failed requests from their app. They're preparing to engage their infra team.

incident-bot: Deploy event: /deploy queue showed a small rollout 12m ago to eu2 (model-variants). No automatic rollback triggered.

customer-sre-lynx: Confirmed — we see 5xx across multiple pods in eu2. We can drain traffic from eu2 if you need to trigger a regional shift. What's the expected impact during DNS cutover?

oncall-javi: TL;DR: Plan is warm failover to eu1, keep capacity warmed in eu1 ded pool, then shift traffic via edge routing + DNS TTL trick. No DNS TTL lowering in progress yet. We need signoff from lynx before changing customer-visible routing.

sre-maya: Repro steps/observations:
- errors concentrated on nodes: eu2-gpu-14..18
- kernel logs show NIC link retries at 10s intervals for those hosts
- internal k8s drain of eu2-gpu-16 shows immediate drop in 5xx for a minute then other nodes compensate -> indicates capacity is constrained or CPU sat on proxy.

Suggest: 1) isolate affected nodes, 2) warm eu1 pool + standby nodes for lynx, 3) execute two-phase traffic shift (LB weight shift then DNS change)

eng-ralph: Ops checklist I'm prepared to run (ETA 8-12m):
1. Start warm instances in eu1 dedicated pool for lynx (manual scaleup script)
2. Pre-warm KV caches by replaying recent prefixes (safe mode)
3. Adjust edge routing policy to send 10% -> eu1, monitor for 5m, then 50%, then 100%
4. Lower customer zones TTL to 30s prior to DNS record swap

I can kick off prewarm now if we have thumbs.

cs-ana: Lynx SRE asked about session affinity and sticky routing — will traffic reattachment break their long-lived sessions?

customer-sre-lynx: Our clients use short-lived connections mostly; we expect minimal reconnection cost. We prefer gradual shift. Go ahead with warm if you think it's safe.

oncall-javi: Decision: proceed with warm failover. Communication plan: cs-ana will post an update to lynx every 10m. We'll mark maintenance windows in console. Post-failover retrospective to follow.

eng-ralph: Running prewarm script now: 
```bash
./scripts/warm_pool.sh --tenant lynx --region eu1 --replicas 8 --model stable-13b
```

deploy-bot: Job started: warm_pool.sh (id: wp-2264508888-01). Logs: https://deploys.redwood/logs/wp-2264508888-01

incident-bot: Note: capacity commit for lynx in eu1 available as burst capacity. Billing flags set accordingly.

sre-maya: Evicting eu2-gpu-16 and eu2-gpu-17 from pool. Marking as quarantined for investigation.

eng-ralph: Prewarm completed, KV prefill reached ~65% expected hit rate. Latency profile in eu1 looks nominal. Ready for weighted edge shift.

oncall-javi: Executing edge weight shift: 10% -> eu1 now. Monitoring metrics and errors.

sre-maya: Metrics: 10% shift shows eu1 handling requests fine, eu2 5xx rate drops from 42% -> 28%. Good sign.

eng-ralph: Advancing to 50% -> eu1. Doubling check healthchecks.

customer-sre-lynx: We see traffic to eu1. Some clients log reauths but overall success rate improving. Keep going.

cs-ana: Posted update in lynx support channel: "We started warm failover to eu1; rolling shift in progress. We'll update every 10m. No action required from you unless you see client errors >5%." :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Automated check: DNS TTL is currently 300s for lynx.foo.example. Recommend lowering to 30s before DNS swap.

eng-ralph: I'll lower TTL now (internal dns-op request queued). @dns-op can you apply TTL change?

dns-op: TTL change submitted: zone lynx.foo.example, A records TTL 30s. Propagation expected within 2m. Logged change id dns-2264508888-ttl.

sre-maya: Observing connection patterns: some retries failing on eu2-side proxies. We should schedule a rolling restart of proxy process on eu2 after traffic fully shifted.

oncall-javi: Approaching 100% weight to eu1 in 3m if health holds. Current error-rate aggregate at 6% across regions.

eng-ralph: 100% -> eu1 now. Edge routing confirms all new sessions originating to eu1.

customer-sre-lynx: Confirming application-level telemetry shows errors reduced to baseline. Thank you. We'll leave a 1h watch and then request root-cause timeline.

cs-ana: Communicated to lynx: "Cutover complete; monitoring for 1h. We'll follow up with RCA and remediation plan. Please ping if you see regression".

incident-bot: Post-cutover automated checks: synthetic requests success 99.4% to eu1. No active alerts for lynx in eu1.

eng-ralph: Now that traffic is in eu1, initiating controlled remediation on eu2: cordon/quarantine affected hosts and collect full kernel + dmesg + netstat logs for debugging.

sre-maya: I've started a data capture job and snapshotting GPU metrics for eu2-gpu-14..18. Uploading to case: https://cases.redwood/lynx-eu2-2264508888

dns-op: TTL restore scheduled: will revert to 300s after 60m of stable metrics or on request.

oncall-javi: Handoff plan: I'll stay on for the 1h watch, then @sre-maya will own the RCA + follow-up with lynx. Postmortem channel to be created. Any objections?

customer-sre-lynx: No objections. Appreciate the fast response. We may ask for a timeline to prevent recurrence (noisy neighbor?), will coordinate with eng team.

cs-ana: I'll coordinate the follow-up call and collect logs they need. Thanks team. :heart:

incident-bot: Incident incident-2264508888 transitioned to "stabilized". Please file postmortem if >30m customer impact.

oncall-javi: Filing initial incident ticket and linking this thread. Closing active pager. Leaving watch task for @sre-maya.

sre-maya: Acknowledged. Starting RCA draft.

eng-ralph: Quick note for postmortem — check autoscaler churn and kernel NIC driver versions on eu2 hosts. Suspect an OS-level regression triggered by a driver update last week.

customer-sre-lynx: Logged request for pre-scheduled failover runbook review. We'll want a test plan for future rehearsals.

cs-ana: Copy that. I'll set up a runbook review in calendar and invite lynx SRE + oncall.

incident-bot: This thread will auto-archive after incident ticket closure.

oncall-javi: Good job everyone. Closing thread in 1h if stable. :white_check_mark:
